website.description: Disabled-by-default experimental provider. It logs into the HealthPlanet website and uses an unofficial internal endpoint. TANITA does not guarantee this endpoint, and it may change or stop working without notice. Cookies, CSRF tokens, HTML, and raw JSON are kept only in memory.
